text: ity, Dali YUNNAN 671000, China)[KEY WORDS] atorvastatin;pharmacokinetics;hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase inhibitors;polymorphism, single nucleotide[ABSTRACT] Atorvastatin is the most commonly used blood lipid medication, which can significantly reduce the plasma low-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels and prevent cardiovascular diseases. But for different individuals, the efficacies of atorvastatin are very different. The studies had shown that gene polymorphisms were the important factors led to diversity of pharmacokinetics in different individuals. The pharmacokinetic characteristics of atorvastatin and its gene polymorphisms were reviewed in this paper to supply some advices for the individual use of atorvastatin in clinic.[作者简介] 郝芳芳（1988—），女，白族，云南鹤庆人，硕士研究生，主要从事临床药理研究，Phn：86-872-2257，ext 412，E-mail：dalihff@yahoo.com.cn；
